Penita is a dead Sister of the Open Hand Assuagia on a ship in Act Three.

Involvement

Act Three

Penita's corpse is onboard the Lustrous Lass at the Grey Harbour Docks at X: -178 Y: -233. She carries the book  The Lustrous Lass. She was sent to investigate the quarantined ship but fell to its curse as well before she could find out what had happened.

Notes

  • All found victims of the curse aboard the Lustrous Lass are bald.
